decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit draws on the firm's core plural-component expertise and serves steady construction repair demand, so it is likely to stay in the range.
As a companion injection unit to Product A, it covers different capacities, and capital equipment needs spare-parts continuity, which makes withdrawal unlikely.
Automatic airless guns are a core accessory with steady demand from industrial coating lines and support pump sales.
A manual airless gun is a staple high-volume accessory that generates aftermarket revenue and is rarely discontinued.
The data logger is a niche product but fits digitalization and quality documentation trends, so the firm is more likely to update it than drop it.
